name: go-fuzz-entry
description: A function named Fuzz, or Fuzz followed by a name that does not open with a lower-case letter, of type func([]byte) int, in a file whose build constraint holds with the gofuzz tag set, is a root, because go-fuzz calls it by name. A function of another type in that file, and one of that type in a file whose constraint holds only without the tag, are reported. go-fuzz fixes an entry point's signature, so a parameter it does not read is not reported.
